'''Keir Santage'''<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia" /> was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot]] who participated in the [[Battle of Endor]]. He was killed when his [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] was destroyed by the lead pursuing [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] inside the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Second Death Star]] superstructure.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Biography==
In [[4 ABY]], the night before the [[Battle of Endor]], [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] declared during a [[sabacc]] game aboard ''[[Home One]]'', which included [[Wes Janson]], [[Wedge Antilles]], and [[Norra Wexley]], that Santage was running a game in the ship's ready room that required players to lose their clothes.<ref name="TheBuyIn">{{StoryCite|story=The Buy-In|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}</ref>
